author: MS
premise: A retired naval captain who has never spoken of a mutiny he suppressed in his youth is asked by a young historian to describe it for a book. The captain refuses. The historian then produces a letter, written by a mutineer the captain hanged, that tells the story differently.
setting: A house on the Kent coast, 1830s

author: MS
premise: A young physician obsessed with discovering the cause of a wasting fever that killed his sister conducts experiments on himself in secret. As his health declines, his betrothed begs him to stop. He believes he is on the edge of a discovery that will save thousands.
setting: A medical school in Edinburgh, 1820s

author: MS
premise: In a future England governed as a republic, a young statesman who has dedicated his life to the public good is told that a famine in the colonies will reach the home country within a year. His colleagues prefer to hope it will not. He must decide whether to tell the people.
setting: London, late in the twenty-first century

author: MS
premise: A young widow whose husband drowned within a year of their marriage retires to a cottage by the sea. She refuses all company. A shy neighbour, a girl of fifteen who also lost a parent to the sea, begins leaving wild flowers at her door.
setting: A cottage on the Devon coast, 1820s

author: MS
premise: A girl taken in as a ward by a wealthy family is treated as a daughter until the family's own son falls in love with her. The mother, who had planned a grander match, begins to remind the girl gently and constantly of how much she owes them.
setting: A great house in Hampshire, 1830s

author: MS
premise: A young Sicilian fisherman rescues a nobleman's son from a storm at sea and is rewarded with a place in the nobleman's household. He rises in favour, and the nobleman's steward, who has served thirty years, sets out to ruin him.
setting: A palace and fishing village in Sicily, 1790s

author: MS
premise: A small community survives in the ruins of a great city after a pestilence. Its leader, a former soldier, wishes to rebuild; his rival, a former priest, believes the pestilence was a judgement and that rebuilding is blasphemy. The young people of the community must choose between them.
setting: The ruins of a European city, late in the twenty-first century

author: MS
premise: An astronomer who has devoted his life to mapping the heavens loses his sight. His daughter, who has assisted him for years, offers to continue the work. He refuses to believe a woman capable of it, and she must prove him wrong without breaking his heart.
setting: An observatory on a hill in Surrey, 1810s

author: MS
premise: A young man falsely accused of a crime committed by his father is tried and acquitted, but his reputation is ruined. His father, who could clear him, remains silent. The son must decide whether to expose his father or bear the shame himself.
setting: An assize town in the north of England, 1820s

author: MS
premise: A young woman who has kept house for her brother, a struggling artist, for ten years learns that he means to marry a rich widow and give up painting. She believes he is betraying his gift. He believes she is jealous of his happiness.
setting: Rooms in Rome and a villa near Naples, 1820s

author: MS
premise: In a future age when all nations are at peace, a sudden failure of the harvests across Europe tests the bonds between them. An English envoy sent to a congress in Vienna must persuade the nations to share their reserves, while his own countrymen demand that England keep everything.
setting: Vienna, late in the twenty-first century

author: MS
premise: A young chemist who believes he can restore memory to the old by a tincture of his own devising tests it on his grandfather, who has forgotten everyone. The old man remembers, and among the things he remembers is a crime that the family has kept hidden for forty years.
setting: A university town in Saxony, 1790s

author: MS
premise: A widow who keeps a respectable lodging house is visited by a stranger who knows that she was once married under another name, to a man who was transported for forgery. He asks for money. She must decide whether her present life is worth what he demands.
setting: A lodging house in Bath, 1830s

author: MS
premise: A poet who has lost his wife and child in a single winter travels alone through the Alps, seeking solitude. In a mountain inn he meets an old Swiss guide who lost his own family in an avalanche and who has made his peace with the mountains.
setting: An inn in the Bernese Alps, 1810s

author: MS
premise: A young woman of the future, born into a world depopulated by disease, sets out on foot across England to find her brother, from whom she has had no word for a year. Along the empty roads she meets other wanderers, each carrying a grief she recognises.
setting: England, late in the twenty-first century

author: MS
premise: A young heiress whose father was killed in a duel learns that the man who killed him is now a respected member of Parliament, and is about to marry her closest friend. She has proof of the duel. She must decide whether to speak.
setting: London, 1820s

author: MS
premise: A naturalist sails to Iceland to study its volcanoes, accompanied by his young wife, who has insisted on coming. On the voyage she proves the better observer. He must decide whether to put her name beside his on the paper he will read to the Royal Society.
setting: Iceland and a ship in the North Atlantic, 1810s

author: MS
premise: An English girl travelling with her family in Italy is courted by a young Italian patriot who is plotting against the Austrian rulers of his city. Her father forbids the acquaintance. When the patriot is arrested, she must decide whether to plead for him.
setting: Milan, 1820s

author: MS
premise: A popular general of a future English republic, returning victorious from a war in the East, is urged by his followers to make himself dictator. His oldest friend, a member of the assembly, must decide whether to oppose him in public and lose his friendship forever.
setting: London, late in the twenty-first century

author: MS
premise: A young woman who has nursed her mother through a long and terrible illness is left alone in the world at nineteen. A distant relative offers her a home. She refuses, and resolves to live by herself in her mother's cottage, though the village thinks her strange.
setting: A village in Wales, 1820s

author: MS
premise: A man whose testimony sent his business partner to prison for a fraud he himself committed is visited, twenty years later, by the partner's daughter, who has come to ask for work as his secretary. She does not know who he is.
setting: A merchant's house in Bristol, 1830s

author: MS
premise: A young woman who has secretly studied natural philosophy from her brother's books is discovered by her father, a strict clergyman. He forbids her studies. A visiting professor, a friend of her brother's, is the only one who takes her seriously.
setting: A rectory in Shropshire, 1810s

author: MS
premise: In a future England where a long sickness has emptied the towns, a young schoolmistress continues to ring the school bell every morning, though only three children remain. A government inspector arrives to close the school.
setting: A village in Oxfordshire, late in the twenty-first century

author: MS
premise: A young officer returning from the Peninsular War discovers that his late father's fortune was made in the slave trade. He is engaged to a woman of strong abolitionist views. He must decide whether to tell her before the wedding.
setting: A country house in Gloucestershire, 1814

author: MS
premise: A young woman engaged to a man she admires discovers that her mother opposed the match because she herself was once in love with the young man's father. The mother refuses to explain further. The daughter must decide whether the past has any claim on her future.
setting: A house in Yorkshire, 1810s

author: MS
premise: A mechanician who has built an automaton that plays chess is invited to exhibit it before a royal court. The automaton wins every game. Only the mechanician knows how, and the secret begins to weigh on him.
setting: A royal court in Germany, 1790s

author: MS
premise: A ship carrying refugees from a stricken continent arrives at an English port. The townspeople, fearing infection, refuse to let them land. A young doctor among the townspeople argues that compassion is a duty. The town's council meets through the night.
setting: A port on the south coast of England, late in the twenty-first century

author: MS
premise: A woman who abandoned her infant daughter in a foundling hospital twenty years before, to save her own reputation, is now a wealthy widow. She learns that her daughter is a seamstress in poverty. She must decide whether to claim her and expose herself.
setting: London, 1830s

author: MS
premise: An old man who has outlived his wife, his children, and all his friends lives alone in a decaying manor. A young tenant farmer's daughter begins to visit him, and he finds himself telling her the story of his life, which no one has ever heard.
setting: A manor in Cumberland, 1830s

author: MS
premise: A young engineer designs a great bridge that will span a gorge in the Alps. His patron, a nobleman, demands that it be finished before winter. The engineer knows it is unsafe. He must decide whether to delay and lose his patron or finish and risk lives.
setting: A gorge in Savoy, 1820s

author: MS
premise: In a future England where a sickness has emptied the cities, a band of survivors elects a young woman as their leader. She has never sought power. She must decide whether to lead them north to the coast or keep them in the valley they know.
setting: The Severn valley, late in the twenty-first century

author: MS
premise: A respected judge learns that a man he sentenced to death years before was innocent. The true criminal has confessed on his deathbed. The judge must decide whether to make the truth public and ruin himself.
setting: An assize town in the west of England, 1830s

author: MS
premise: An English painter living in Florence falls in love with a young Italian woman who sits for him. Her family intend her for a convent. He must decide whether to help her escape, knowing he cannot offer her marriage.
setting: Florence, 1820s

author: MS
premise: A young man whose friend died saving him from drowning cannot forgive himself. He visits the friend's family, who receive him kindly, and he cannot bear their kindness. The friend's sister, who blames him, is the only one he can talk to.
setting: A village in Cornwall, 1820s

author: MS
premise: A scholar of the future, living in a world that has survived a great pestilence, writes a history of the catastrophe for those who will come after. As he writes, he realises that the pestilence has returned.
setting: An English university town, late in the twenty-first century

author: MS
premise: A young woman's guardian, a wealthy and generous man, asks her to marry him. She is grateful and fond of him. On the eve of her decision, she learns that he was once engaged to her mother and that her mother broke the engagement for her father.
setting: A country house in Kent, 1830s

author: MS
premise: A gifted young man who wishes to become a great poet is told by a famous critic that his work has no merit. He burns his manuscripts and resolves to become a man of science instead. His sister, who has kept copies of his poems, does not tell him.
setting: London, 1810s

author: MS
premise: A young man and woman, the last survivors of their village after a plague, decide to set out together to find other people. They are strangers to each other. On the road they must learn to trust each other, and to decide what they owe to the dead.
setting: The English countryside, late in the twenty-first century

author: MS
premise: A young man who has always believed himself the son of a poor curate learns that he is the illegitimate son of a nobleman. The nobleman, now dying, wishes to acknowledge him. The curate, who raised him, does not wish to lose him.
setting: A parsonage and a great house in Northumberland, 1830s

author: MS
premise: A woman who has lost her husband and children in an epidemic retires to a convent in Italy, though she is not a Catholic. The nuns accept her. A young novice, who is also grieving, attaches herself to the Englishwoman.
setting: A convent near Lucca, 1820s

author: MS
premise: In a future England, a great storm destroys the harvest and the people turn against their government. A young aristocrat who has always despised politics finds himself called upon to speak for the people in Parliament.
setting: London, late in the twenty-first century

author: MS
premise: An elderly woman who has lived a life of quiet virtue in a provincial town confesses on her deathbed to her doctor that she once betrayed her closest friend to a man who ruined her. She asks the doctor to find the friend's descendants and ask their forgiveness.
setting: A provincial town in the Midlands, 1830s

author: MS
premise: A natural philosopher who has spent his life trying to prove the existence of a vital fluid in living things is challenged by a younger rival to a public demonstration. The philosopher's experiments have never quite worked. His reputation depends on this one.
setting: The Royal Institution, London, 1810s

author: MS
premise: A young woman of the future, a nurse in a hospital overwhelmed by a mysterious disease, falls in love with a patient who will not recover. She knows what she is doing, and does it anyway.
setting: A hospital in London, late in the twenty-first century

author: MS
premise: A wealthy manufacturer who rose from poverty by cheating his first employer is now a celebrated benefactor of his town. The employer's grandson, a young schoolmaster, has been invited to give the address at the opening of the benefactor's new school.
setting: A town in Lancashire, 1830s

author: MS
premise: A young woman jilted on the eve of her wedding by a man she loved shuts herself away from the world. Her younger brother, a lively boy of fourteen, refuses to let her withdraw, and drags her out to the hills each morning.
setting: A house in the Peak District, 1820s

author: MS
premise: In a future Europe where nations have dwindled after a pestilence, an English physician sails to Lisbon in search of a remedy said to have been found there. The city he finds is calm, orderly, and unwilling to share what it knows.
setting: Lisbon, late in the twenty-first century

author: MS
premise: A girl raised by a reclusive man she believes to be her uncle finds a miniature portrait of a woman who looks exactly like her. He tells her the woman was his sister. The local vicar, who knew the family, tells her something else.
setting: A remote house on the Welsh coast, 1830s

author: MS
premise: A young man who has dedicated himself to the cause of liberty sails to Greece to fight in the war of independence. He finds the war squalid and the cause divided. His letters home grow darker, and his sister, who encouraged him to go, reads them with growing guilt.
setting: Greece and England, 1820s

author: MS
premise: A young woman in a future England, surviving alone in a village after a sickness, hears church bells ringing in the next valley. She has not heard another human sound in a year. She sets out at once, afraid of what she will find and more afraid of not going.
setting: The Cotswolds, late in the twenty-first century

author: MS
premise: A young woman discovers that her fiancé, whom she adores, fought a duel years ago in which he killed a man who was defending his sister's honour. The man's sister is now a governess in the house where the wedding is to take place.
setting: A country house in Sussex, 1830s

author: MS
premise: A girl whose closest friend has died of consumption spends a summer writing letters to the dead friend, as if she still lived. Her mother finds the letters and fears for her daughter's mind.
setting: A village in Devon, 1820s

author: MS
premise: In a future England, a prophet arises who claims that the pestilence is a punishment and that only his followers will be spared. A young doctor who has seen the disease up close sets out to expose him, and finds the prophet sincere.
setting: A town in the English Midlands, late in the twenty-first century

author: MS
premise: An Italian nobleman's daughter, betrothed to a man she has never met, flees her father's palace on the eve of the wedding and takes refuge with a band of mountain peasants. Her betrothed follows her, and she does not recognise him.
setting: The mountains of Calabria, 1790s

author: MS
premise: A respected banker discovers that his wife, before their marriage, gave birth to a child she gave away. The child, now grown, has come to the town and is asking questions. The banker must decide whether to help his wife or protect his name.
setting: A provincial town in Yorkshire, 1830s

author: MS
premise: A woman who has written a novel that brought her fame is shunned by society when her authorship is revealed. Her husband, a man of science, is embarrassed by her success and forbids her to write again.
setting: London, 1820s

author: MS
premise: A small group of survivors in a future world decides to send a ship across the Atlantic to look for other people. The volunteers are a young couple, an old sailor, and a child who refuses to be left behind.
setting: A port in Cornwall, late in the twenty-first century

author: MS
premise: A woman who has spent her life caring for her invalid father is left nothing in his will, which divides his estate between her two brothers. They offer her a small allowance. She refuses it, and announces she will become a governess at forty.
setting: A country house in Lancashire, 1810s

author: MS
premise: A young man who has always been told that his mother died at his birth learns that she is alive and has spent twenty years in an asylum. His father had her confined. The young man goes to see her.
setting: An asylum near London, 1830s

author: MS
premise: In a future England slowly recovering from a pestilence, a woman who lost her children to the disease is asked to take in an orphan. She refuses. The orphan, a silent boy of six, keeps returning to her door.
setting: A village in Berkshire, late in the twenty-first century
